paite: Rehoboam bel Shekem ah ahoh a; Israelte tengteng Shekem ah kumpipa dia bawl ding in ahoh khinta uhi.
heading: Mallam Namte Helna / (1 Kum 12.1-20)
english: Rehoboam went to Shechem, for all Israel had come to Shechem to make him king.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Nebat tapa Jeroboam in huai thu azak in, Aigupta gam a kipan Jeroboam ahong pai nawn hi; amah kumpipa Solomon kiang a kipan ataimangna Aigupta gam a om lai ahi ngal a.
english: When Jeroboam the son of Nebat heard of it (for he was in Egypt, where he had fled from the presence of King Solomon), Jeroboam returned out of Egypt.

paite: Mi asawl ua, ava sam ua; huchi in Jeroboam leh Israel tengteng ahong pai ua, Rehoboam kiang ah,
english: They sent and called him; and Jeroboam and all Israel came, and they spoke to Rehoboam, saying,

paite: "Na pa'n ka hakkol uh agiksak mahmah a; huaiziak in na pa'n hon zat gimna leh ahakkol giktak ka tung ua akoih hon sukzangsak inla, huchi in nang nna ka sem ding uh," chi in agen uhi.
english: “Your father made our yoke grievous. Now therefore make the grievous service of your father and his heavy yoke which he put on us, lighter, and we will serve you.”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Ni thum khit chiang in hong pai nawn zaw un," achi a, huchi in mipite akihemkhia uhi.
english: He said to them, “Come again to me after three days.” So the people departed.

paite: Kumpipa Rehoboam in, "Hiai mipite dawnna ding thupha bang ahia na hon hilh ding uh?" chi in apa Solomon dam lai a upate kiang ah adong hi.
english: King Rehoboam took counsel with the old men, who had stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived, saying, “What counsel do you give me about how to answer these people?”

paite: Amau akiang ah, "Hiai mipite na hehpih a na kipahsak a, akiang ua thuhoih tata na genleh tangtawn in na mite ahi ding uh," chi in agen uhi.
english: They spoke to him, saying, “If you are kind to these people, please them, and speak good words to them, then they will be your servants forever.”

paite: Himahleh, upate hoihsakpih apom kei a, amah khanvualpih tangvalte, akiang a om sekte adong zosop hi.
english: But he abandoned the counsel of the old men which they had given him, and took counsel with the young men who had grown up with him, who stood before him.

paite: Akiang uah, "Hiai mipite ka kiang a, 'Na pa'n ka tung ua hakkol akoih hon hihzangsak in chi a gen mite ka dawndan ding hoih bang ahia na hon hilh ding uh?" " achi hi.
english: He said to them, “What counsel do you give, that we may give an answer to these people, who have spoken to me, saying, ‘Make the yoke that your father put on us lighter’?”

paite: Akhanvualpih tangvalte'n akiang ah hiai mipite na pa'n ahakkol uh ahihgik thei mahmah a, nang zaw hon hihzangsakzaw in na kiang a hong gen mite kiang ah huchi in chi inla, huchi in akiang uah gen in, "Ka pa kawng sang in ka khutzung agolzaw.
english: The young men who had grown up with him spoke to him, saying, “Thus you shall tell the people who spoke to you, saying, ‘Your father made our yoke heavy, but make it lighter on us;’ thus you shall say to them, ‘My little finger is thicker than my father’s waist.

paite: Ka pa'n hakkol giktak ahon na posak a, ke'n ahihleh na hakkol uh behlap lai ding ka hi, ka pa'n khetna in nou ahon sawi zel a, ke'n ahihleh aikam a hon sawi ding ka hi," chi in agen uhi.
english: Now whereas my father burdened you with a heavy yoke, I will add to your yoke. My father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.’”

paite: Huchi in Jeroboam leh mipite tengteng kumpipa'n, "Ani thum khit chiang in hong nawn un, achih bang in ni thum ni in Rehoboam kiang ah ahoh uhi.
english: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam the third day, as the king asked, saying, “Come to me again the third day.”

paite: Kumpipa'n amaute gumtak in adawng a, kumpipa Rehoboam in upate thuhilhna apom kei.
english: The king answered them roughly; and King Rehoboam abandoned the counsel of the old men,

paite: Tangvalte phatsakpih bang in, ka pa'n na hakkol uh ahihgik a, ke'n huai behlap ding ka hi; ka pa'n khetna in nou ahon na sawi a, ke'n zaw aikam a nou hon sawi ding ka hi," achi hi.
english: and spoke to them after the counsel of the young men, saying, “My father made your yoke heavy, but I will add to it. My father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.”

paite: Huchi in TOUPA'N Shilon mi Ahijah zang a, Nebat tapa Jeroboam kiang a athu gensa akipsak theihna ding in kumpipa'n mite thugen Pathian ziak in apom kei hi.
english: So the king didn’t listen to the people; for it was brought about by God, that Yahweh might establish his word, which he spoke by Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam the son of Nebat.

paite: Kumpipa'n athu uh apom kei chih Israelte tengteng in atheih un mipite'n: "David ah tantuan bang ahia i neih uh? Jesse tapa ah gouluah ding i nei sam kei uh, Israel mite aw, na puanin lam chiat uah pai un: David, na inkuan sung ngaihtuah mai in, chi in kumpipa adawng uhi." Huchi in Israel tengteng apuanin lam uah apaita uhi.
english: When all Israel saw that the king didn’t listen to them, the people answered the king, saying, “What portion do we have in David? We don’t have an inheritance in the son of Jesse! Every man to your tents, Israel! Now see to your own house, David.” So all Israel departed to their tents.

paite: Israel suan Judah gam khua a omte bel atung uah Rehoboam in vai ahawm hi.
english: But as for the children of Israel who lived in the cities of Judah, Rehoboam reigned over them.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa Rehoboam in phutluih nasem dia asawlte uh heutu Hadoram asawl a; amah huai Israelte tengteng in suang in ana deng ua, asita hi. Jerusalem a tai tum in akangtalai ah kumpipa Rehoboam atuang pah hi.
english: Then King Rehoboam sent Hadoram, who was over the men subject to forced labor; and the children of Israel stoned him to death with stones. King Rehoboam hurried to get himself up to his chariot, to flee to Jerusalem.

paite: Huchi in tutan in David inkote tung ah Israelte ahelta uhi.
english: So Israel rebelled against David’s house to this day.
